mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 6.0%), the Federal Reserve's aggressive tightening policy leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has been below 104.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) growth exceeds 1.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months, it indicates strong consumer spending that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS MoM growth > 1.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS MoM growth has exceeded 1.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals an overheating labor market correction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS declines from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 3.5% and PAYEMS declines from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.0% and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals a severe economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and UNRATE > 4.0%.
